title: Grim Reaper Ritual
description: A skeletal Grim Reaper in a black robe stands at the center of a glowing green spiral portal, holding a lit green candle. The surreal scene includes a giant purple draped figure with a single green eye watching from above, a cracked red planet, scattered red shards, white butterflies, mystical books and objects on blue-draped tables, and dark mountains in the background.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene with a skeletal Grim Reaper in black robes standing in the center of a glowing green spiral vortex, holding a lit green candle. A giant purple draped cosmic figure with one large green eye watches from the top left. A cracked red planet floats in the sky above dark jagged mountains. White butterflies flutter around the scene. Mystical books, candles, and occult objects rest on blue draped tables on both sides. Dramatic lighting, intricate details, painted style.
